items.title: Duncan Sheik Dead At 56
items.summary: Duncan Sheik has died. The New Jersey-born singer-songwriter, best known for the pop-rock hit “Barely Breathing” and the musical Spring Awakening , passed away last night in a hospital in Manhattan. His mother, Suzanne Sheik, told the New York Times the cause of death was cardiac arrest. "Duncan was a father, husband, son, brother, and friend," reads a statement shared on his social media. "He will be remembered for his sensitivity, wit, inteligence, and depth of spirit he brought to those who knew and loved him." Sheik was 56.
